'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Zaporizhzhia strikes (2022–present)|Battle of Zaporizhzhia]]
****Nine people die after they are hit by [[Russia]]n shelling in [[Zaporizhzhia]]. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/news-pmn/shelling-kills-nine-in-outskirts-of-ukraines-zaporizhzhia-deputy-mayor (''National Post'')]
***[[Southern Ukraine offensive]]
****A [[Russian Air Force|Russian]] missile strike destroys a [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] barracks in [[Mykolaiv]], killing at least 50 soldiers, many more are believed to be buried under rubble. [https://news.sky.com/story/ukraine-war-dozens-of-soldiers-feared-dead-after-attack-on-mykolaiv-barracks-while-troops-slept-12570330 (Sky News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[Russian Central Bank]] is considering splitting its stock exchange into two separate stock exchanges, one for Russian residents and the other for foreigners. [https://www.forbes.ru/investicii/459511-cb-obsuzdaet-razdelenie-rynka-akcij-na-ofsornyj-i-onsornyj (''Forbes Russia'')]
*The [[National Union of Rail, Maritime and Transport Workers]] organizes protests in [[Dover]], [[Liverpool]] and [[Kingston upon Hull]] after [[P&O Ferries]] fired all British crew members across its entire fleet of [[ferry|ferries]] and replaced them with cheaper [[employment agency|agency workers]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-60779001 (BBC News)]
*The [[1915 Çanakkale Bridge|Çanakkale 1915 Bridge]], connecting the European and Asian continents in [[Turkey]], is opened for traffic. It surpasses [[Japan]]'s [[Akashi Kaikyō Bridge]] as the world's longest suspension bridge. [https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/turkey-worlds-biggest-bridge/index.html (CNN)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four crew members are killed as a [[United States Marine Corps]] [[Bell Boeing V-22 Osprey|MV-22B Osprey]] aircraft crashes in [[Beiarn]], [[Norway]], while participating in the [[NATO]] military exercise [[Cold Response]]. [https://www.nrk.no/norge/amerikansk-militaerfly-har-styrtet-i-nordland-1.15899499 (NRK)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/osprey-v-22-crash-norway/ (CBS News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] ends all remaining [[COVID-19]] restrictions on international travel. [https://centreforaviation.com/analysis/reports/uk-ends-travel-restrictions-returns-as-no-1-european-aviation-market-600809 (Centre for Aviation)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ecuador]]
***[[Ecuador]] ends the restrictions of public and private gathering designated to curb the spread of COVID-19 after the country reached 85% of its [[COVID-19 vaccination in Ecuador|vaccinated]] population. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuador-ends-covid-limits-gatherings-after-hitting-vaccination-goal-2022-03-18/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
***[[Hong Kong]] surpasses 1 million cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.6389391 (CBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
***Russian negotiator [[Vladimir Medinsky]] says that progress has been made regarding the neutrality status of Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russian-official-sees-progress-with-ukraine-neutrality-not-denazification-2022-03-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Western Sahara conflict]]
**[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Spain)|Spanish minister of foreign affairs]] [[José Manuel Albares]] announces that Spain supports Morocco's proposal to recognize [[Western Sahara]] as a Moroccan autonomy for the first time, as it considers it is "the most serious, realistic, and credible basis" for resolving the conflict. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/03/19/world/europe/spain-morocco-western-sahara.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[President of Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz President]] [[Sadyr Japarov]] signs a law to rename the town of Isfana as [[Razzaqov]] in honor of former Secretary of the [[Communist Party of Kirghizia]] [[Iskhak Razzakov]]. The law was passed by the [[Supreme Council (Kyrgyzstan)|Kyrgyzstan Parliament]] on March 16. [https://akipress.com/news:669145:Isfana_town_named_after_statesman_Iskhak_Razzakov/ (AKIPress)]
